title: Chapter 1876: Taking Action (II)
content:
Chapter 1876: Taking Action (II)

Temple of Gained Affection.

Lesser Broadsky Mountain was hardly a great spiritual mountain. Indeed, the entire Western Sea had few such places. The territories of these divine ability cultivators were mostly islands. Even Xiehu merely resided in [Sandalwood Plain Desert].

Abbot Shehu had moved Lesser Broadsky Mountain himself. Few in this remote Western Sea were skilled in moving mountains, and there were no fine mountains to bring over anyway. It merely had the shape of a mountain, with temples scattered across it and black winds gusting through.

Sensual sounds filled the [Dharma Hearing Hall] above. Two rows of nuns stood inside, all shackled, holding stones in their mouths and carrying earth on their backs. A dark-red table stood in the center. A naked woman slowly approached on her knees, retrieved a rounded object from ice water, sliced it thinly, and arranged it in a bowl. She picked up a piece using a pair of chopsticks and fed it to the middle-aged man seated above.

The middle-aged man had a kindly face, a slightly pointed chin, and the robes of an abbot. A faint smile rested on his face. His throat moved as he swallowed, and he exhaled.

Abbot Shehu was not originally a cultivator of the Western Sea, but a demonic cultivator from the north who had cultivated on the outskirts of the Northern Sea's Plume-Shedding Grounds. His bloodline was distinguished, and his talent exceptional. Thanks to a favor owed to his forebears, he had received a spirit item from the Tongxin Tree. After years of patient cultivation, he attained the Dao.

After attaining the Dao, however, he gradually grew ostentatious and traveled widely. But in the Eastern Sea, Maha Shejie of the [Abhidharma Treasury Temple Sect] imprisoned him in a secret place for a hundred years. Forced to listen to endless scriptures, his mind was gravely damaged.

Later, he took advantage of widespread upheaval to steal Maha Shejie's treasured spirit tree and escape, but he could not shake off its influence. He still retained some clarity then and knew to cultivate a Fate Divine Ability. Yet after decades of failure, Shehu grew increasingly indolent.

Nothing interested Shehu anymore.

Life ends in death. What point is there in doing anything?

Only his hatred of Shejie remained, sustaining his atrocities at the Temple of Gained Affection. As he coldly watched the nuns suffer, a figure in green approached and knelt in the hall.

"Abbot... A Daoist Master has arrived outside. He says he comes from Jiangnan... an old acquaintance of some Daoist Master Yuanxiu. He wishes to speak with you at length..."

The demon raised his brows. "Yuanxiu?... He must have something of [Orthodox Wood] to trade."

He had obtained his Fate Divine Ability cultivation technique from Yuanxiu, so the name was familiar. Though it stirred no greed in him, he decided to meet the visitor. Taking the plate from the table, he rose and left the hall. Upon descending the mountain, he found a Daoist Master waiting outside.

Li Ximing was studying him as well. This demon had kindly features and clear eyes. Had he not been holding a plate of sliced heart and liver, still weeping blood, he might truly have passed for a charitable man.

Li Ximing wasted no time on pleasantries. He smiled and said, "Take a look, fellow Daoist!"

He swept up his sleeve. Guided and concentrated by [Valley Wind Leading Fire], the various spiritual flames within him gathered in his palm. He raised his hand in a plain, unadorned strike and brought it down toward the demon's face!

"You... I...?"

Even after a thousand years of cultivation, Shehu had never encountered anything so absurd. This cultivator had traveled all the way from Jiangnan, said 'Take a look, fellow Daoist', and, without using any art or spirit artifact, simply tried to slap him across the face!

"

Huh?

"

Bewildered though he was, his divine ability swiftly sensed the danger emanating from that palm. Yet the hand looked warm and smooth as jade, without the slightest trace of a divine ability. A flash of anger split through Shehu's confusion.

Are there still cultivators of [Kui's Body] in this age?!

Though he lacked a Fate Divine Ability, he could still recognize danger. He immediately opened his mouth and spat out a streak of green and yellow light.

The light coalesced into a bronze basin the size of a human face, ancient in style and engraved with intricate patterns. There was something distinctly Buddhist about it. Green birds circled above it, weaving and darting through brilliant, shifting colors!

Boom!

Li Ximing's long-prepared palm struck the center of the basin, unleashing a dense storm of flame. The bronze basin rattled violently and turned red-hot, yet visibly expanded as it tried to contain all the fire!

Li Ximing's strike was purely an art of fire control, prepared well in advance. It would be most powerful if it landed directly on someone's body, but even so, a spirit artifact spat out in haste could never stop it!

The various spiritual flames were all contained. Only one brilliant white radiance burst free.

[Heavenly Crow Merging Fire]!

Shehu clearly recognized the infamous flame, or at least knew that Merging Fire was exceedingly dangerous. His expression changed drastically. Crushing a jade talisman, he brought his hands together as the shifting radiance of Orthodox Wood surged around him, hard as metal.

"[Back Facing South]!"

Endless gales and thunder instantly filled the sky, crossing and converging as they swept toward them. The [Heavenly Crow Merging Fire] blazed brighter, yet began swaying wildly. The demon's form grew impossibly light and elusive, remaining just beyond the surging flames.

Back Facing South... So it can command wind and thunder to evade fire!

Having discussed this Dao with Sima Yuanli, Li Ximing understood its workings almost immediately. He withdrew his palm with some regret, but Heavenly light was already descending, forming a resplendent heavenly gate that plunged toward Shehu!

No! He's trying to kill me!

Shehu's brows shot up, and cold sweat broke out over him. His expression grim, he had no time for further preparations. He simply raised his hand and decisively drew out a talisman!

[Dao Valley Profound Radiance Talisman]

He had acquired this talisman long ago to save his life. Sensing that his opponent had come prepared, he used it without hesitation. His figure immediately dissolved into surging Valley Water.

Then, the scenery before him shifted rapidly. Before Shehu could draw breath, another heavenly gate descended from above, translucent as jade, pure white and radiant. It rapidly filled his disbelieving eyes!

It was even more overpowering and terrifying than the first!

There's another one!

Heavenly light blazed, and the clouds vanished. High above stood a young man in dark qilin armor, halberd in hand. The scroll he held unfurled, sending layer upon layer of color cascading from the sky!

The Bright Yang spirit treasure, [Huai River Map]!
